rework_notes: Review rejected the previous attempt. it does not conform to the Contract: The required push-delivery test does not prove the <2000ms delivery bound: _observe_in_dom timestamps user.find against NiceGUI's server-side element tree, which render() updates before WebSocket delivery, while the separately recorded WebSocket emit is allowed up to 10 seconds and is not included in the latency assertion. Consequently, a delayed second-client update can pass, contrary to the Contract's requirement not to substitute callback-side receipt for client rendering.
